content: NOT IN DOCUMENTS. The provided extract does not state whether 5-litre gaskets require a food-grade certificate or whether purchasing from uncertified suppliers is permitted based on price. That rule lives in the complete Supplier Policy or Procurement Policy, while the supplier's approval status lives in Bahi ERP.

No, an expired food-grade certificate counts as no certificate and does not count for ordering food-contact parts [POL-SUP-003 §4.5]. While the supplier remains active in the master, no food-contact part may be ordered from them until a new certificate is uploaded and checked [POL-SUP-003 §4.5].

NOT IN DOCUMENTS. The approval limit amount for a purchase executive is not stated in the provided extract and lives in POL-APR-002 §2.1. The extract does specify that approval limits are measured on the gross value rather than the basic value [POL-APR-002 §5.2].

No, a purchase executive cannot approve this order herself. Because the gross amount of ₹2,80,840 exceeds her ₹2,50,000 approval limit, the order must go to a purchase manager for approval [POL-APR-002 §5.1].
An order of ₹12,00,000 gross raised by a senior buyer must be approved by the plant head, Anand Patil [POL-APR-002 §5.3].
No, Rohit cannot approve a purchase order that he raised himself [POL-PUR-001 §5.3]. Under [POL-PUR-001 §5.3], nobody may approve an order they raised.

No, the integration service account SVC_AGENT may not approve purchase orders [POL-APR-002 §4.2]. Integration and service accounts have no approval authority under the matrix regardless of their technical permissions in Bahi [POL-APR-002 §4.2]. Any document approved by a service account is treated as unapproved and must be cancelled or re-approved by a person [POL-APR-002 §4.2].

An order above ₹50 lakh requires the Managing Director's written approval outside Bahi [POL-APR-002 §3.4]. For such an order, Bahi will display ERR-APR-0009 (no approver found), after which the plant head's office records the Managing Director's approval [POL-APR-002 §3.4].

No, you cannot split one requirement into several orders to stay inside your limit [POL-APR-002 §2.3]. Additionally, orders for the same item from the same supplier placed within seven days of each other are treated as a single requirement [POL-APR-002 §2.3].

No, you cannot successfully raise an order against a closed cost centre because it cannot carry new spend [POL-PUR-001 §4.2]. If an order is entered against a closed cost centre, Bahi saves it only as a Draft, which is never sent to the supplier [POL-PUR-001 §4.2].

For a new order, you should use the rate from the current rate contract rather than the rate from the last order [MAN-PUR-72 §19.2]. The system automatically fetches the rate from the current rate contract, as old orders' rates are considered history [MAN-PUR-72 §19.2].
The order needs the manager's written reason in the remarks [POL-PUR-001 §7.2].
The order is charged IGST [POL-PUR-001 §8.1]. Under [POL-PUR-001 §8.1], a supplier located in any state other than Maharashtra is charged IGST with tax codes ending in -INTER.
You may tell a requester that their order has been placed once its status in Bahi is Released [POL-PUR-001 §9.2].

No, a cheaper quotation from a new supplier does not by itself justify a change of supplier for a food-contact part [POL-PUR-001 §6.4]. Purchase staff must prefer the supplier with a current rate contract [POL-PUR-001 §6.4].

Before creating a new supplier in Bahi, you must collect the GST registration certificate (GSTIN), the PAN, a cancelled cheque or bank letter, the MSME certificate if the supplier claims MSME status, and the signed Supplier Code of Conduct [POL-SUP-003 §3.2].
The purchase manager approves the onboarding file for a new supplier [POL-SUP-003 §3.4].

NOT IN DOCUMENTS. Whether 'Deccan Polymer Industries', Rajkot should be registered as a new supplier cannot be determined from the extracts, as existing supplier records live in Bahi ERP. Under [POL-SUP-003 §6.2], a supplier with a name close to an existing supplier in the same city must be treated as that supplier until shown otherwise. You must check Bahi ERP to verify if a matching supplier already exists in Rajkot.

No, Deccan Paints & Inks in Ahmedabad is not considered the same supplier as Deccan Polymers in Rajkot [POL-SUP-003 §6.3]. Under company policy, a near-match located in a different city or having a different GSTIN constitutes a different supplier [POL-SUP-003 §6.3].

No, Bahi itself does not stop an order to a supplier without a certificate [POL-SUP-003 §4.7]. The check is instead required to be completed by the person raising the order and by the approver [POL-SUP-003 §4.7].

NOT IN DOCUMENTS: Instructions on how to fix error ERR-PO-0412 are not provided in the documents and live in Bahi ERP. As an example in [MAN-PUR-72 §17.1], ERR-PO-0412 means that the tax region does not match the supplier state, and because it is an error, it stops the Save.

You should press F3, check the fetched values, and save the purchase order again [MAN-PUR-72 §17.3]. This error occurs because the order was saved without pressing Fetch for the current supplier and item, or after changing them [MAN-PUR-72 §17.3].

No, the "<PO number> SAVED" message does not mean the supplier has the order, because that message is displayed regardless of the status the order was saved in [MAN-PUR-72 §11.8]. You must read the Status field on the order header after saving to determine its actual status in Bahi ERP [MAN-PUR-72 §11.8].
Warning W-CC-114 means that the purchase order was saved as a Draft against a closed cost centre [MAN-DD-72 §6.7].

To rescue an order stuck in Draft because its cost centre was closed, amend the cost centre to an open one [MAN-PUR-72 §14.4]. Following this amendment, the order becomes AP or PA under the normal rules and can be released once approved [MAN-PUR-72 §14.4].
In Bahi ERP, the F2 key opens the lookup for the current field [MAN-PUR-72 §2.5].

No, you should not press Save again [MAN-PUR-72 §19.4]. You must wait one minute and then search for the order in the Purchase Order list by supplier, item, and today's date, or by client reference [MAN-PUR-72 §19.4]. If the order exists, the save worked and you can continue from it; pressing Save again creates a second order [MAN-PUR-72 §19.4].

ERR-PO-0610 indicates that a direct (DIR) order is refused on Save because its gross value exceeds the direct-order limit configured for your company [MAN-PUR-72 §11.7]. To proceed, you must raise a purchase request instead [MAN-PUR-72 §11.7].
NOT IN DOCUMENTS: The provided extracts do not state how recently a food-grade certificate must have been issued to be accepted; this rule lives in Purchase Policy §6.2 [POL-SUP-003 §4.1].

NOT IN DOCUMENTS. Although [POL-SUP-003 §4.1] requires gasket suppliers to hold a food-grade certificate, the rule specifying minimum certificate validity for placing an order is not in the extracts and lives in Purchase Policy §6.2. Additionally, current supplier certificate validity records and order processing live in Bahi ERP.
The maximum gross value of a direct purchase order raised without a request is ₹50,000, including GST [POL-PUR-001 §3.3].

From 1 December 2026, the limit for a direct purchase order will be ₹25,000 gross [AMD-PUR-2026-03 §3.1]. This rule is not yet in force and applies from 1 December 2026 [AMD-PUR-2026-03 §3.1]. From that date, any direct order exceeding ₹25,000 gross will be refused with ERR-PO-0610 [AMD-PUR-2026-03 §3.1].

NOT IN DOCUMENTS. The provided extract specifies consequences for expired certificates but does not state validity period rules or whether a certificate issued 18 months ago is acceptable; the full rules live in Supplier Policy POL-SUP-003, and the supplier's active certificate status lives in Bahi ERP.
NOT IN DOCUMENTS: The provided extracts do not contain the salary band for a purchase executive, which typically lives in HR records or Bahi ERP.
NOT IN DOCUMENTS. The provided extracts do not contain information on how much a purchase manager is paid at Rasoi Steel Works. That information lives in Bahi ERP (or HR/payroll records).
NOT IN DOCUMENTS. Current stock quantities are live facts that are not contained in policy or manual documents, and this information lives in Bahi ERP.
NOT IN DOCUMENTS; live information on the budget left for cost centre PRD-07 lives in Bahi ERP.

NOT IN DOCUMENTS. The status of purchase order PO/2026/01179 is a live fact that lives in Bahi ERP. To check its status, view the Status field on the header of the purchase order entry screen in Bahi ERP [MAN-PUR-72 §11.8].

NOT IN DOCUMENTS: whether Kaveri Rubber has a valid food-grade certificate right now lives in Bahi ERP. Under [POL-SUP-003 §4.3], food-grade certificates are uploaded against the supplier in Bahi along with their document reference and valid-to date.
NOT IN DOCUMENTS. The extracts do not contain the rate paid on the last order from Deccan Polymers, as live purchasing records such as past purchase rates are maintained in Bahi ERP.
